chapterInfo.content:
1
AWURADE bɛba abɛbu wiase atɛn
1 # Yer 26.18; Yes 1.1 AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Moresetni Mika nkyɛn, Yuda ahemfo Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia berɛ soɔ no a ɔhunuu no Samaria ne Yerusalem ho nie.
2Aman nyinaa, montie, asase ne ne mayɛ, monwɛn aso,
na AWURADE Nyankopɔn nyɛ ɔdanseni ntia mo,
AWURADE a ɔwɔ n’asɔrefie kronkron mu no.
3 # Amos 4.13 Na hwɛ, AWURADE refiri adi afiri n’afa,
na wasiane abɛtiatia asase sorɔnsorɔmmea so.
4Na mmepɔ bɛnanenane wɔ n’ase,
na mmonhwa mu apaepae,
sɛdeɛ akraa nane wɔ ogya anim no,
te sɛ nsuo a wɔahwie agu deɛ ɛhɔ siane.
5 # Yer 23.13-14 Yakob mmarato
ne Israel fie nnebɔne nti na yei nyinaa ba.
Ɛdeɛn ne Yakob mmarato?
Ɛnyɛ ɛne Samaria anaa?
Na ɛdeɛn ne Yuda sorɔnsorɔmmea?
Ɛnyɛ ɛne Yerusalem anaa?
Samaria ne Yerusalem sɛeɛ
6Na mede Samaria bɛyɛ wiram aboɔkuo
ne abobe atɛeɛ,
na mede n’aboɔ bɛgu bonhwa no mu,
na mayi ne nnyinasoɔ adi.
7 # Hos 2.5, 12 Na wɔbɛbobɔ n’ahoni nyinaa,
na wɔde ogya ahye n’ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa,
na mɛyɛ n’abosom adum nyinaa afo,
ɛfiri sɛ adwamamfoɔ apɛdeɛ na ɔde aboa ano,
na adwamamfoɔ apɛdeɛ na ɛbɛsane akɔyɛ.
8Yei nti mɛsu na matwa adwo,
mɛnante kwaterekwa ne adagya mu,
mɛtue su mu sɛ ɛserɛ so kraman,
na madi abooboo sɛ sohori.
9Na n’apirakuro no aporɔ.
Na abɛduru Yuda,
abɛso me man pono ano,
aduru Yerusalem.
10 # 2 Sa 1.20 Monnka nnkyerɛ Gat,
esu nso monnkɔsu;
Bet-leafra na
monyantam mfuturo mu.
11Safirfoɔ,
monsene nkɔ,
adagya aniwuo mu;
Saananfoɔ
mfiri adi;
Bet-esel agyaadwotwa
ma mo gyinabea bɔ mo;
12na Marotfoɔ
de ahoyera twɛn mmerɛ pa,
ɛfiri sɛ bɔne afiri AWURADE nkyɛn
aduru aba Yerusalem kuro pono ano.
13Lakisfoɔ,
momfa teaseɛnam nsa ɔpɔnkɔ hoɔharefoɔ;
ɛyɛɛ Sion babaa
bɔne mfitiaseɛ,
sɛ wo mu na wɔhunuu
Israel mmaratodeɛ no.
14Enti wobɛma Moreset-gat
nkradie akyɛdeɛ:
Aksib afie di
Israel ahemfo hwammɔ.
15Maresafoɔ
mede ɔdedifoɔ foforɔ bɛbrɛ mo;
Adulam na Israel
animuonyamfoɔ bɛduro.
16Bɔ tikwa na wewɛre wo ho,
w’anigyeɛ mma nti
ma wo tikwa ntrɛ sɛ ɔpɛtɛ deɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔatu wo nkyɛn kɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
